title: Stability lane weekboard and rollout solo checklist
content:
Purpose: lightweight, single-operator rollout plan for small-stable releases (patches and hotfix lanes). Use when: low-risk change set, <1% traffic impact, short rollback surface. Goals: keep latency SLO, maintain 99.95% availability, verify prefix KV cache correctness, and confirm model-routing fallbacks behave as expected.

Context and constraints:
- Release window: weekday evening (PST) quiet-window 20:00–23:00. Prefer Tues/Thurs.
- Expected traffic: baseline +5% for a 30m period post-rollout.
- Dependencies: config flag toggle (feature-flag-id: ff/kv-cache-2028-06), minor runtime patch (PR 1228), no DB migrations.
- Capacity plan: 10% headroom required; ensure autoscaler has a 15m warmup.

Pre-flight (T-72h to T-1h):
- T-72h: Draft release notes (short bulleted summary). Tag primary oncall. Chore: add smoke test vector for new path.
- T-48h: Run traffic replay locally against canary infra. Note: use small batch of representative prompts (prompt-suite: stability-small).
- T-24h: Telemetry prebaseline snapshot (save 24h median p50/p95/p99 for tokens/sec, latency, error-rate). Export to shared s3 folder.
- T-6h: Verify model artifact checksum and storage hash. Confirm rollback image is available and tested.
- T-1h: Preflight runbook readout in #release-ops channel. Confirm staff (one operator, one observer).

Step-by-step rollout (operator solo flow):
0) Pre-announce: post short note to stakeholder channel with expected window and rollback plan.
1) Canary deploy to 2% routing for 10 minutes. Actions: verify canary health (green) in console, no new 5xx.
2) Run quick smoke script (./scripts/smoke-rollout.sh) against canary: checks = health, simple generation, kv-cache warmup, streaming chunking. Record outputs.
3) If canary passes: expand to 25% over 15 minutes. Observe: latency p95, error rate, token throughput.
4) Midpoint probe at 25%: run longer qps load for 10m using loadkit. Compare telemetry to prebaseline.
5) If stable: full ramp to 100% in two steps (60% -> 100%), pausing 10 minutes between steps. Monitor dashboards actively.

Abort / rollback criteria (trigger immediate rollback):
- sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m OR
- error rate spike > 0.5% absolute OR
- KV-cache hit ratio drop > 15% OR
- any regression in critical smoke tests (generation fails, malformed streaming).

Rollback quick steps:
- Mark traffic route to previous stable model variant.
- Revert feature flag (ff/kv-cache-2028-06 -> off).
- Re-deploy rollback image and pin to prior commit.
- Notify SRE and create incident ticket with description + telemetry snapshot.

Observability checklist (what to watch):
- Dashboards: per-model latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec, request rate, error rate (5xx), KV-cache hit ratio, memory pressure per GPU.
- Traces: sampling at 20% for first 30m after each step. Look for span additions >10ms in attention kernels.
- Logs: grep for new error types: "kv-cache-miss", "compile-fallback", "tensor-sync-failure".
- Alerts: have alert acknowledgers ready; suppress noisy infra alerts for the window if validated.

Smoke test matrix (runnable, names):
- smoke-basic-gen: simple prompt -> short completion. Expect 200/OK, latency < 150ms p95.
- smoke-stream-join: streaming response, verify chunk order and final token.
- smoke-cache-hit: warm prefix then re-request; expect hit ratio >= 70% within 60s.
- smoke-failure-mode: provide malformed input, assert graceful error (400) not 500.

Rollout calendar (compact):
- Day -3: draft notes + prompt vectors assembled. Owner: Ava.
- Day -2: replay + canary harness test. Owner: Diego.
- Day -1: telemetry snapshot + ops readout. Owner: Liam.
- Day 0 (20:00): begin canary 2%. (20:10) smoke-basic-gen. (20:25) 25% ramp. (20:40) midpoint probe. (21:00) 60% ramp. (21:10) 100% complete. (21:30) final checks and close out.
- Day +1: morning digest with telemetry diffs and rollback flag evaluation. Owner: Sofia.

Release notes (draft):
- Title: runtime: small kv-cache correctness fix + streaming chunk alignment
- Short: Fixes a bug causing occasional cache-miss after prefix refresh and improves streaming chunk reliability for long responses. No API changes.
- Impact: internal routing + cache behavior; customers should see fewer partial responses on long streaming generations.
- Migration: none. Recommends: clients should tolerate occasional re-requests during in-flight KV refresh.
- Risk: low (no schema/migration). Observability added for cache-miss spikes.

Post-release verification (T+0 to T+24h):
- T+0.5h: confirm smoke matrix passes against prod traffic.
- T+3h: check daily batch analytics job didn't regress.
- T+8h: run synthesis test harness (long-form conversation) for 500 flows.
- T+24h: produce rollout digest (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, kv-hit-trend) and post to #releases.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Should we widen trace sampling to 50% for first 10m after full ramp? pros/cons.
- Add explicit step to run blackbox client sessions from EU region during ramp (latency differences).
- Confirm whether billing tags change for this deploy (billing-team FYI).

Communication templates (short snippets):
- Pre-window: "Planned patch deploy tonight 20:00–21:30 PST. Expect brief canary at 2% then ramp. Contact @Ava for ops."
- Post-success: "Deploy complete. No regressions observed in primary metrics. Digest: <link>."
- Post-rollback: "Rollback executed at <time>. Impacted traffic reverted to stable. Incident ticket: <ticket>."

Quick annex: emergency contact list
- primary operator: Ava Chen (pager)
- SRE backup: Diego Martinez (slack)
- Product owner: Liam Patel (email)

Notes: keep this doc short and copy into a release-specific readme when executing. If solo-operator flow is used, reduce noise by keeping the run focused: one action at a time, log every decision, and default to rollback if unsure.

----- end
